hero.lead: Short audio stories about places you pass every day. Find a stand, tap your phone on the tag and listen.

steps.title: Find a stand
steps.text: Stands are placed by seven buildings — in the centre, on Plotinka and in Uralmash. You can spot them from afar: a red burst and the stop number.

steps.title: Tap your phone
steps.text: The NFC tag is in the red circle. No NFC? There is a QR code next to it. No app needed: everything opens in the browser.

steps.title: Listen and move on
steps.text: A short audio story about the place where you stand. After it, the next stop of the route opens.

route.title: Seven houses, seven stories
route.text: From the Mamin-Sibiryak House Museum to the White Tower in Uralmash. Stories open in order, like episodes.

why.title: Facts you want to retell
why.text: We take verified stories about Yekaterinburg and tell them the way you share news with friends: briefly, with details and intonation. Everything you hear is true. Just without the lecture.
why.quote: a rumour lives while it is retold: levelled, sharpened and fitted to the teller
why.quoteSource: G. Allport and L. Postman, The Psychology of Rumor, 1947

items.title: On site only
items.text: A story opens at its stand, right by the building. You can't just forward the link: you have to come.

items.title: In order
items.text: The route unfolds like a series: the next story opens after the previous one.

items.title: No app
items.text: Works in your phone browser via NFC or QR. In Russian, English and Chinese.

cta.title: The first stop is closer than it seems
cta.text: Open the map, pick the nearest stand and the city will start talking.
